title: Analysis code: differentiating notified dengue from malaria in Kolkata from routine surveillance fields (leakage-audited machine learning, 2014-2025)
description: Analysis code for the study 'Differentiating notified dengue from malaria in Kolkata from routine surveillance fields: a leakage-audited machine-learning study, 2014-2025'. Includes data preparation, the leakage-safe benchmark (seven classifiers, five class-imbalance strategies, five random splits and a temporal split), the leakage audit, field ablations, calibration and decision-curve analyses, figures, ward-level spatial statistics, a synthetic example dataset, and derived ward-level result tables without patient information. The Kolkata Municipal Corporation line-lists and the licensed ward boundaries are not included.
